protocol.target_selection: geometric grid over the common attained log-RMSE range, trimmed 2% of the log-span at each end; retrospective
protocol.crossing_rule: first crossing, log-log interpolation between adjacent tested budgets, no extrapolation
protocol.censoring: left crossing bounded by [0, smallest tested budget], right by [largest tested budget, infinity]; every draw contributes ratio bounds; none discarded

empirical.unit: replication rows, jointly for coupled methods, independently for rollout streams and across budgets

gaussian_summary_only.note: MSE ~ N(mse, mse_se) clipped at zero; used only where replication files were not retained

protocol.interpretation: pointwise exploratory percentile envelopes, conditional on the tested grid, target selection, and interpolation convention; not simultaneous confidence bands; observed grid brackets are in results/cost_to_accuracy.json
